text:
alex: Hey — thinking about a new PowerBoard dashboard to help SREs and capacity planners. Goal: correlate node-level power draw / power-capping events with allocations that drive them, plus compact sparklines for fleet rollups. Want ideas for panels, PromQL, and alert conditions. cc @nina @raj

nina: Love this. Must-have panels: 1) per-node rolling percentiles (p50/p90/p99) of node_power_watts, 2) a table with a sparkline + current power cap status, 3) stacked tenant contribution to node power (top N) and rest.

raj: High-cardinality tenants will blow up the grafana panels. Suggest: precompute top 10 tenants by 24h energy and persist a tenant_rank label in recording rules. Then visuals can safely show top10 + others.

alex: Good call. How do you want the sparkline cell sized? Small row-per-node or condensed grid? We have ~1200 GPUs across 60 nodes in each rack region.

nina: Small row-per-node for ops page (clickable to node dashboard). Condensed grid for capacity planning view (rack or region aggregation).

raj: For queries: use recording rules like "node_power_watts:rate5m" and "alloc_gpu_power:rate5m" so panels are lightweight. Also attach node label to allocation metrics at ingest to avoid expensive joins.

tim: Example PromQL for p90 per node: ```
quantile_over_time(0.9, node_power_watts:rate5m[1h])
```

tim: Basic tenant share per node (topN precomputed): ```
sum by (node, tenant) (rate(alloc_gpu_power_watts_sum[5m]))
```

alex: Trying to show "power capped" intervals. We emit node_power_capped_total (counter increments when throttle engaged). Any suggestions for alert rule?

sarah: Alert idea: node_power_capped_total increases by >0 over 3m AND node_power_watts > node_power_cap_watts * 0.98 for same window => persistent capping under heavy load. Action: annotate node for forced scaling or migration.

raj: Alert PromQL (draft): ```
increase(node_power_capped_total[3m]) > 0 and on (node) (avg_over_time(node_power_watts[3m]) > avg_over_time(node_power_cap_watts[3m]) * 0.98)
```

alex: Nice. Also want an ops view that shows which allocations are present during cap windows. We have alloc_gpu_power{allocation_id,tenant,node}. Can we show a stacked timeline per node with allocation_ids?

nina: Stacked timeline OK but metric cardinality might explode. Limit to allocation age < 24h and top 5 active allocations by power. Use label_replace to map allocation -> short id for display.

raj: Quick join example for allocation fraction of node power: ```
sum by(node, tenant) (rate(alloc_gpu_power_watts_sum[5m])) / sum by(node) (node_power_watts)
```

alex: Will prototype a dashboard using the above. I'll add a grafana row for: Region rollup, Rack rollup, Node list (table+sparklines), Node detail panel (top tenants + allocation timeline), Power cap alerts timeline.

monitor-bot: Draft dashboard "PowerBoard v1" has been provisioned to grafana/drafts/powerboard_v1.json (no folders).

alex: Thanks @monitor-bot. Next steps: I will create a recording-rule PR for the topN tenant rank and node_power_watts:rate5m. @tim can you help wire the sparklines into the node table? @sarah please sanity-check alert thresholds.

sarah: Yep, will review alert thresholds this afternoon. Consider a lower severity for noisy nodes (flapping) and a P1 if >3 nodes in same rack hit persistent cap.

tim: I can handle the sparkline panels. Also recommend adding a small grafana expression panel showing allocation-to-power ratio to catch misbehaving allocs.

alex: Awesome. I'll open the dashboard PR and link here. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
